description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL (Phobos Shadow Force, 1 CP) at the end of the OPPONENT's Fight phase — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. Every engaged unit counts as having fought (setup privilege); the Fight and Consolidate steps end (REAL clicks); fight_phase_end opens for the Space Marine player (the Ork player has nothing to offer); a REAL click on the Scout Squad (SCOUT SQUAD, unengaged) spends 1 CP; it is placed in strategic reserves.
